explanation: This line is inside a "moving argument" — one LaTeX also writes somewhere else, such as a section title into the table of contents, or a caption into the list of figures — and \footnote does something LaTeX cannot safely redo in that second place. Either write `\protect\footnote` right before it, or give the outer command (`\section`, `\caption`, ...) a plain-text short version in its optional argument: `\section[short title]{full title with \footnote{...}}`.
title: \footnote cannot be used here directly
